findings.summary: Docs PR on button and link semantic conflict when rendering; no open bug relevant to a plain button Fab.

notChecked: only one mui/base-ui query (useRender button type) was run

differences.where: every Fab (including speed-dial's two Fab usages)
differences.reference: Radix: <button> has no type attribute, so inside a <form> it defaults to type=submit
differences.branch: Base UI useRender: <button> renders with type="button", so it never submits a form
differences.how: Open /gallery#components, scroll to #fab, inspect any [data-slot=fab]: getAttribute('type') is null on reference, 'button' on branch

apiChanges: asChild prop would become render (no consumer uses asChild)
viewports: 1280x900 requested; the browser viewport rendered about 500x700 for both builds
notes: Compared 11 gallery Fabs by computed style: tag, data-variant, data-size, class length, size, colors, radius, font size and shadow were identical, and screenshots looked identical. Only difference found is the type attribute. Not checked: keyboard focus ring, hover/press, speed-dial interaction, 390x844 screenshots, true 1280x900 screenshots. Swap was written, then reverted.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI useRender adds type="button" to the rendered button while the Radix version emits no type attribute (default submit behaviour). Per WORKER.md 4b a button's default type is a perceptible behavioural difference. Retry if the team accepts type=button as intended (no Fab in the repo sits inside a form), or if Fab is changed to set the type explicitly on both versions first.
